title: State store shared definitions
description: The record envelope every kind carries (shared/state-store.xml#envelope). Node schemas $ref #/$defs/envelope and add their body fields. The id form is the UTC-stamp form N-01 owns; see rejected-with-reason.xml#envelope-id-form for the r-prefixed form that was rejected.

id.description: UTC stamp, the status code, five lowercase alphanumerics; unique per writer

at.description: UTC, second precision; assigned by N-01 at commit when absent on input

code.description: a value of shared/status-codes.xml#codes; N-01 validates against the live code table, this enum is the book's copy

lease_token.description: fencing token from entity counter:lease_token; only grows

by.description: node id or seat id that wrote the record

key.description: idempotency key; same key same payload replays 200; different payload is 409

version.description: expected version for a compare-and-swap put; 0 inserts

seq.description: assigned by N-01 at commit; never on input
